data.long_meaning: The name Hrehaan is derived from Sanskrit, and it is a name associated with Lord Krishna. In Hindu mythology, Krishna is known as the eighth avatar of the god Vishnu. Hrehaan is a powerful name that represents divinity, love, and protection. The name Hrehaan carries the meaning “Lord Krishna's name” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hrehaan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord krishna's name and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Hrehaan holds immense spiritual significance for Hindus. It is believed that invoking the name of Lord Krishna, and by extension, Hrehaan, bestows protection, strength, and love upon those who call upon it.
